title: The onboarding item binds only proofs the loop can produce without adding files
description: The item `graphyard up` files for a repository with no tests names the repository's first e2e case and an independent review, with no unit proof or closed question that would need a file beyond the onboarding files, so the merge trial and the reviewer can pass it and it merges without hand requirements or attest.

steps.name: Build the onboarding work request and check its proofs
